chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
How wonderful is man that sees with fat, talks with a piece of flesh, hears with a bone and breathes through a hole.
ai.seo_question: What are the marvels of human anatomy according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this famous aphorism from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) employs a poetic anatomical metaphor to illustrate the divine precision in human creation, where distinct physical substances serve specific sensory functions. This reflection underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on *tadabbur* (contemplation) of the body as a sign (*ayah*) of God’s power, linking physical structure to spiritual awareness. It serves as a reminder that the human vessel, though composed of humble elements, is intricately designed to facilitate worship and perception of the divine.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 8. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
How wonderful is man that sees with fat, talks with a piece of flesh, hears with a bone and breathes through a hole.
